service.ar: تأشيرة العمل عن بُعد في أبوظبي

about: One-year residence for people who work remotely for an employer outside the UAE.
note: Requirements read from the official ADDED long-term residency page on the checked date. The visa itself is applied for through ICP, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Work remotely for an employer based outside the UAE
Monthly income of at least USD 3,500 or the equivalent
documents: Proof of employment outside the UAE
Bank statements for the last 6 months showing a deposit or income of at least USD 3,500 a month
channels: ADDED contact line 800555, 8 am to 3 pm, or contact@tamm.abudhabi
